baseline.method: Published constrained inverse with independently executed original elastic forward; explicit correction of source force-balance defect

threshold_provenance: Before local corrected implementation, success criteria fixed in private photoelastic_corrected_success_criteria.md: exact static balance<1e-9N, map NRMSE1e-4 and parameter relative1e-3; local vs independently executed original-forward constrained oracle map NRMSE2.0844e-8, force error<1.2e-7N, direction error<7.5e-6rad. Reference agreement is not physical truth.
fit_mask_definition: Only optical fitting uses radius0.96R, as published PeGS2; all stress pixels and every force/direction are evaluated with no scoring crop.
mechanical_definition: net_force_fraction=norm(sum_j(Fcos(beta-alpha),-Fsin(beta-alpha)))/sumF; torque_fraction=abs(sum(Fsin(alpha)))/sumF. Both dimensionless; zero total force is assigned1 and fails.
